title: Technical Document Writer
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
--------------------------


You will develop accurate, user\-centric, and technically sound documentation for SCADA systems in wind turbine operations, supporting engineering, commissioning, operations, and maintenance teams.


The role requires close collaboration with SCADA engineers, network architects, software developers, and field technicians to document highly technical content related to wind farm control systems, networking architecture, data acquisition, and remote monitoring. You will translate complex engineering concepts into clear and usable documentation, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with industry standards.

-----------------------------

* Develop system architecture and topology diagrams
* Prepare network configuration guides (switches, routers, firewalls)
* Document communication protocols (e.g., IEC 60870\-5\-104, Modbus, OPC)
* Develop installation and commissioning manuals
* Define cybersecurity and access control procedures

* Create end\-user and admin operation guides

* Translate complex engineering concepts into clear documentation for technical and non\-technical stakeholders

* Use documentation tools such as MS Office, Excel, Visio, Markdown, LaTeX, XML/DITA, and version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Ensure consistency in format, terminology, and compliance with industry standards and company style guidelines

* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 to 6 years of experience
* Experience as a technical writer in the energy, automation, or SCADA domain
* Solid understanding of SCADA systems, industrial networking, and data acquisition principles
* Familiarity with wind turbine operations, control systems, and remote monitoring tools

* Proficiency in creating structured technical documents using tools like MS Office, Excel, Visio, Xmetal, LaTeX, Markdown, or Sphinx
